scope_tiers.description: Reaction-recognition foundation from the NCERT Class X oxidation/reduction treatment.
Formal electron-transfer, oxidation-number and agent-role reasoning within the NCERT Class XI Redox envelope.
Formal ionic/half-reaction balancing depth retained as held product scope unless separately selected.

asset_bindings.downstream_scope: Internal legacy concept identifier only. Learner-facing realization must use direct electron-loss/electron-gain and oxidation-number language rather than mnemonic authority.
Formal oxidation-number reasoning within Class XI Redox scope.
Agent role is derived causally from the reactant's own oxidation/reduction and electron effect; it is not attributed as verbatim NCERT wording.
Foundation reaction recognition is source-defined; formal electron/oxidation-number annotations require FORMAL_G11 authorization.
Formal agent assignment is authorized only after identity, oxidation-state and electron-change reasoning.
Formally source-authorized Class XI balancing depth, but held outside the current Grade 9 Core1A product unless separately selected by product scope.

preferred_surface_language: oxidation: electron loss / oxidation number increases
reduction: electron gain / oxidation number decreases
oxidising agent is reduced; reducing agent is oxidised

repair_records.repair: Separates Class X reaction-recognition authority from Class XI formal oxidation-number/electron-transfer authority.
Agent-role logic is marked STANDARD_CHEMISTRY_DERIVED instead of being falsely attributed as verbatim source wording.
Formal half-reaction balancing remains an EXTENDED_G11 held tier for the Grade 9 Core1A product.
Legacy mnemonic and architecture labels remain internal and are forbidden on learner-facing product surfaces.
